SELECT 
    p.PERIODDATE AS `报表日期`,
    p.A_STOCKSNAME AS `股票简称`,
    p.A_STOCKCODE AS `股票代码`,
    p.ITEM_NAME AS `产品名称`,
    ROUND(p.INCOME/10000, 3) AS `营业收入(亿元)`,
    p.PRI_RVNU_PCT AS `收入占营业收入比(%)`
FROM 
    STK_PRI_INCOME_PRODUCT p
WHERE 
    p.ISVALID = 1
    AND p.RPT_TYPE = '合并'
    AND p.PERIODDATE = '2025-12-31 00:00:00.000'
    AND p.A_STOCKSNAME LIKE '%万华化学%'
    AND p.ITEM_NAME LIKE '%聚氨酯%'
    AND p.INCOME IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
    p.INCOME DESC
